projectDescription: A collection of configuration files, Lua scripts, and resources for the Assetto Corsa Custom Shaders Patch (CSP), enabling enhanced lighting, weather effects, PBR materials, and visual improvements for cars and tracks.
keyFeatures: Car light configuration (headlights, brake lights, emissive materials, turning indicators)
Track light configuration with dynamic day/night conditions
PBR material templates for cars and tracks
Weather FX system with 24-hour cycle support and Lua-scriptable controllers
Rain FX with windscreen drops, puddles, and wet track rendering
Grass FX with procedurally generated grass
Extra FX post-processing (TAA, SSLR, motion blur, ambient occlusion)
Particles FX with soft particles and improved smoke
Vertex AO patches for prebaked ambient shadows
Automatic distribution via Content Manager API
publicApiSurface: [LIGHT_X] — individual point/spot light definition for cars and tracks
[LIGHT_SERIES_X] — series of lights tied to geometry meshes for tracks
[MATERIAL_ADJUSTMENT_X] — emissive/material property override tied to conditions
[CONDITION_X] — time/weather-based activation condition for track elements
[BOUNCED_LIGHT] — ground light bounce configuration for tracks
[EMISSIVE_LIGHT_X] — emissive car light (brake, headlight, hazard, etc.)
[TEMPLATE: Material_PBR] — PBR material template for car surfaces
[BASIC] ENABLED — master enable/disable toggle present in every extension module
[INCLUDE] — INI file inclusion directive for shared config blocks
script.update(dt) — Lua entry point for weather controllers and camera scripts
ac.setConditionsSet2(conditions) — Lua API to push weather conditions to the sim
